title: Earning Interest on Enterprise Balances
summary: This document explains that enterprise balances earn a 3.0% Annual Percentage Yield (APY), with interest compounded daily. It also describes daily automated liquidity reports to verify interest accruals versus current balances and provides guidance to align operating/reserve balances and adjust sweep rules with your account team.
